short_description: Your computer's live network traffic, down and up, on a speedometer. Not a speed test. Needs a companion on Mac or PC.
description:
Live network traffic of your computer on a speedometer: download on the needle, download and upload in numbers. Not a speed test: it shows what the computer moves right now.

**Setup.** Plug the bar in by USB and run on the computer:

- Mac, Terminal: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrlunev/busybar-net-traffic/main/install.sh | bash
- Windows, PowerShell: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrlunev/busybar-net-traffic/main/install.ps1 | iex

After that the bar works over the cable or the same Wi-Fi.

**Controls:** Back closes the app.

**States:** SET UP, NO PC, NO NET, UPDATE. The back screen shows how to fix each.

**Settings:** dial scale, Auto or fixed from 50 Mbit/s to 10 Gbit/s.

**Privacy:** the companion sends nothing to the internet and answers only devices on the local network.
